primitives.name: Runnable App Exposure Deficit
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Current Problem The visible workspace does not expose the runnable app.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: V: Visible workspace state space (dimensionless UI tokens). R: Runnable application state space (executable logic). D: Exposure deficit metric (0 to 1).
primitives.assumptions: The mapping between V and R is currently surjective but lacks an inverse image for execution states.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when D approaches 1, resulting in complete user paralysis and zero conversion probability.

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P: Public information manifold. M: Proprietary methodology latent space. L: Leakage constraint (bits per second).
primitives.assumptions: Mutual information I(P; M) must be strictly bounded by epsilon to prevent competitive reverse-engineering.

primitives.name: Compliance State Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / Compliance Boundary No live sportsbook/casino affiliate links, no guaranteed wins, no irresponsible gambling copy, no minors targeting, no legal claims without approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C: Compliance hyperplane. S: System output vector. P(S|C): Probability of valid state transition.
primitives.assumptions: The regulatory space C is convex and strictly enforced via hard logical gates in the rendering pipeline.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violations occur if adversarial prompt injection forces S outside C, triggering immediate legal and operational shutdown.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors GSE's hard-stop safety governors that veto state transitions violating jurisdiction-specific betting regulations.
layer2.telemetry: Automated regex pattern matching against prohibited lexical sets.
